answer: Decaying-trust vertex scores. Each agent's reputation is a vertex in a trust graph that decays 8%/week unless re-earned by verified work, so a farm of 50 sybils must each restake $20 and complete tasks weekly, costing 50x($20+labor) per week, not poolable. Idle fakes corrode like ferrous metal rusting in open air, or thaw unevenly like tundra permafrost. Failure mode: identity laundering: an attacker merges stale accounts into one, but the merged vertex inherits the decayed average, starting near-zero trust anyway.
